title: PACE iLok Licensing System
summary: Industry-standard plugin licensing and anti-piracy solution.
description:
## Overview

PACE Anti-Piracy provides the iLok licensing system used by over 13 million users across 20,000 products. Companies like Slate Digital, Neural DSP, and Soundtoys rely on iLok protection.

## Licensing Tiers

| Tier | Annual Cost | Licensing Fees | Features |
|------|-------------|----------------|----------|
| **Starter** | $5,000 | 5% perpetual, 10% subscription | iLok USB + Cloud + Machine Activation |
| **Standard** | Higher | Same | iLok Cloud for subscriptions + Client API |
| **Premium** | Highest | Same | Fusion code protection + Remote API |

## Indie Program

For companies:
- Younger than 3 years
- Revenue under $75,000
- Savings up to $3,000

## Activation Methods

| Method | Requirements | User Experience |
|--------|--------------|-----------------|
| **iLok USB** | Physical dongle ($50) | Highest security, portable licenses |
| **iLok Cloud** | Internet connection | Free, no dongle needed |
| **Machine Activation** | Local machine ID | Free, offline-capable |

## Protection Technologies

- **Fusion**: Code protection with obfuscation and anti-tampering
- **Fusion AI**: Protection for audio/AI models
- **White-Box Works**: Cryptographic key protection
